name: Fujiie Rokurou
source:
"If these are the festival materials, please deliver them to [url=/c136409]Sensei[/url]. Feel free to use them as needed along the way."

The town's Mayor. Now in his seventh term, Rokurou has been a pivotal community leader for many years.

Currently residing alone in his spacious mansion after outliving his wife and seeing his children off to independence, Rokurou is a celebrated and trusted local dignitary, cherished for his gentle nature and open-hearted approach to outsiders. He shows unusual enthusiasm when it comes to the town's traditional festival.

Rokurou is familiar with the 'Koyoukan' in the mountains and that [url=/c136404]Rosemary[/url] regularly stops by his mansion.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara10.html]official website[/url]]
